ideas.name: GDS Round-Trip
ideas.summary: Graph Data Science as a graph transformer: project a subgraph in, run an algorithm, write the results (PageRank, communities, embeddings) back as graph structure.

ideas.name: The Judgment Ledger
ideas.summary: Every model call stored as an edge on the data it judged: provenance, drift and escalation as queries, e.g. which facts rest only on low-confidence calls?

ideas.name: Wikipedia Wedge
ideas.summary: Any article's link neighborhood as a graph file; "what does the article on entropy connect to that information theory doesn't?"

ideas.name: Animated Graph Timelapse
ideas.summary: A temporal graph played over time; the rise and fall of a community, a market, or a pandemic, one WAL frame at a time.

ideas.name: Diff View for Graphs
ideas.summary: Two checkpoints of the same store, visualized as a diff: added/removed/changed nodes and edges. The merge-conflict view for data.

ideas.name: Event Stream to Temporal Graph
ideas.summary: Append-only logs (logs, clicks, packets) into a WAL-backed graph; replay any window and query it as it was.

ideas.name: Direct-Manipulation Graph Editor
ideas.summary: Drag nodes, draw relationships, edit properties in-place; every gesture is a Cypher write under the hood. Undo = query log replay.

ideas.name: Every Character Network Ever
ideas.summary: Any book, script or show turned into a character graph, as a template notebook exercise.

ideas.name: Graph Clipboard
ideas.summary: COPY a subgraph as a file, PASTE it into another instance; the smallest useful data-sharing protocol in existence.

ideas.name: Graph-Native Agent Memory
ideas.summary: A memory that is only a graph: episodes, entities, facts as nodes with timestamps; temporal queries ("what did we agree on before X?") are one hop, not RAG guesswork.

ideas.name: InstantCypher
ideas.summary: Natural-language questions compiled to deterministic, inspectable Cypher rather than free-text answers.

ideas.name: OpenStreetMap Wedge
ideas.summary: OSM PBF extract → nodes/ways/relations; a city's walkable graph in one file, isochrones and shortest paths in milliseconds.

ideas.name: The Emergent Interaction Graph
ideas.summary: Temporal knowledge graphs inferred from communication streams and sensor logs: the graph nobody drew, emerging from the interactions.

ideas.name: The Intentional Graph Workbench
ideas.summary: One internal graph representation with projectional views and editors for every shape it can take: table, diagram, canvas, tree, timeline.

ideas.name: Wiki-as-a-File
ideas.summary: Export a wiki (or its dump) to a single .cl file; a community ships its whole knowledge base as one attachment.

ideas.name: Agent Trace Warehouse
ideas.summary: Spans, tool calls, prompts and costs as a temporal graph; "which retrieval step poisoned this answer?" is a path along the run.

ideas.name: Code Graph
ideas.summary: Parse a repo (tree-sitter) into functions/calls/imports; ask "what breaks if I delete this function?" — reachability in Cypher, on your disk.

ideas.name: Cypher on Cypher
ideas.summary: Run a query over another query's result: a stored, re-parameterizable projection, the dataflow shell for Cypher.

ideas.name: GraphGists, Reborn
ideas.summary: The classic: fenced Cypher in a markdown file renders data + visualization in the browser. Cookbooks, but for community stories.

ideas.name: Query Plans as Graphs
ideas.summary: Every EXPLAIN tree collected into one meta-graph; search plans like code, diff them between versions, mine them for smells.

ideas.name: Spreadsheets are Graphs
ideas.summary: A workbook's formulas, references and sheets as a graph: dependencies, smell detection, and what breaks if I change this cell.

ideas.name: Table Editor to Graph
ideas.summary: Edit rows in a grid while the graph view updates live: the same store, two projections, no import step.

ideas.name: Tools as Graphs
ideas.summary: A large MCP toolset as a graph: typed data dependencies between tools plus call-sequence edges mined from real agent traces.

ideas.name: CSV → Graph, Instantly
ideas.summary: Drop a CSV, pick key columns, relationships materialize; the pull-style pipeline for any tabular source on the web.

ideas.name: Disaster Response Router
ideas.summary: An OSM extract + road-closure edges on a phone; works without cell towers because the graph is local.

ideas.name: Graph School
ideas.summary: A browser-based playground where students load canonical graphs (Karate Club, Les Misérables, C. Elegans) and write their first Cypher against them.

ideas.name: NetworkX Runtime
ideas.summary: nx.compose(relate_graph("file.cl")); your nx algorithms, a Cypher backend. (And GDS-style procedures the other direction.)

ideas.name: Smart-Home State Graph
ideas.summary: HomeAssistant/MQTT events into a temporal property graph; "who turned the lights on at 3am and what triggered it" is a path query.

ideas.name: Software Design X-Rays
ideas.summary: Churn from git history times complexity per file on a temporal graph; hotspots are one query, the trend line is a time-window replay.

ideas.name: Static Sites from Dynamic Graphs
ideas.summary: Generate a Hugo/Astro site from graph queries; the graph is the CMS, the pages are views, and a rebuild is a query.

ideas.name: Team Wiki from a Shared File
ideas.summary: Friends editing a shared graph file on a NAS or in a git repo; conflicts merge because files are the unit.

ideas.name: The Codex, Reborn — an Atlas of History
ideas.summary: Events, locations and people extracted from annotated historical sources into a browsable atlas of history.

ideas.name: The Graph-Walking Agent Cursor
ideas.summary: next_hop(node, goal) as the agent tool instead of run_query: the agent walks real edges, one typed choice at a time, never inventing Cypher.

ideas.name: Wikipedia in Your Pocket
ideas.summary: Offline (sub)graph keeps for mobile: download your article neighborhood before a flight, query it on the plane; the C ABI → mobile wrappers make the phone a first-class graph host.
